AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: An Improved YOLOv8 and OC-SORT Framework for Fish Counting
REGION: Dongshan, Fujian, China (Coral Ecosystem Cabled Observatory, CECO)
SPECIES: 19 reef fish species (e.g., Neopomacentrus violascens >10,000 boxes; Stephanolepis cirrhifer 12 boxes); full list not given
DATA: Own CECO observatory frames: 'several thousand underwater frames' with >40,000 annotated fish (YOLO format); one 5-min 1080p/30 FPS test video annotated in MOT17 format for tracking
V_EV: Sec. 4 Conclusions: 'performance under varying environmental conditions—such as water turbidity and suspended sediment concentration—has not been quantitatively evaluated'
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'stratified sampling was used to divide the dataset into training, validation, and test sets' ... '80% training set ... 10% validation set ... 10% test set'
R_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The dataset used for object detection consists of fish images captured by Coral EcosystemCabled Observatory (CECO) in Dongshan, China' (single source)
C_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'Byte-OCSORT achieves the highest MOTA (72.3) and IDF1 (69.4) while significantly reducing ID switches to 16'
E_EV: Sec. 3.4: 'we did not explicitly compute species-specific classification or counting errors'; only mAP50/mAP50:95/APs (Table 1) and MOTA/IDF1/ID switches (Table 2) reported
ARCH: YOLOv8n with DLKA CSP (deformable large-kernel attention) and TDFI (triple detail feature infusion) modules in the neck; Byte-OCSORT tracker (OC-SORT + ByteTrack two-stage association + Class-Aware Cost Matrix); track-ID-based counting
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50:95, APs (small); MOTA, IDF1, ID switches
NOTE: Framework is titled 'fish counting' but no count is reported or validated: counts are derived from track IDs, and the authors state counting errors were not computed, so E1 = 없음 / E_ALL = N (verifier could argue E1 = 개체수/밀도 with no comparison -> E_ALL = P). V_ALL = N because the Conclusions explicitly state turbidity/sediment effects were not evaluated. Detection confidence thresholds exist (high/low-confidence detection sets) but values are not given (C1 = NR); C_ALL = P from explicit ID-switch handling (C5). Image-level stratified 80/10/10 split from observatory frames (likely consecutive frames of the same videos) with no leakage discussion. 'Trained from scratch without using pretrained weights' (PRE = 없음). Data unavailable due to privacy restrictions; no code link. NIMG not given precisely ('several thousand underwater frames').
